title: Combining Result Sets with UNION and UNION ALL
realWorldScenario: The audit team needs a consolidated feed of credit activity: both loan disbursements and EMI repayments in a single chronological stream.
questionStatement: Write a query combining `type`, `amount`, and `created_at` from `transactions` where `type = 'DISBURSEMENT'` with transactions where `type = 'EMI_REPAYMENT'` using `UNION ALL`. Order the combined results by `created_at` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Consolidated stream with UNION ALL
SELECT type, amount, created_at
FROM transactions
WHERE type = 'DISBURSEMENT'
UNION ALL
SELECT type, amount, created_at
FROM transactions
WHERE type = 'EMI_REPAYMENT'
ORDER BY created_at ASC;
expectedConcepts: Performance difference: UNION vs UNION ALL
hints: Both SELECT statements must have identical numbers of columns and compatible types.
Place the ORDER BY clause after the second SELECT statement.
